The Tokorozawa Corporate Association Hanno Branch will hold the "15th Tax and Fishing Tournament" to help children learn about taxation while enjoying trout fishing in Hanno's beautiful natural setting.

For event details and to apply, please see the flyer and fill in the form below, or complete the application form on the back and submit it by FAX. We look forward to your participation.

Participation Application Form (Opens Microsoft Forms)
